content:
I'd like to assign an icon (even an tropical hut philippines emoji would work) to each account, so that I can quickly tell them apart when I'm choosing which inbox to check. is it possible to do so?

Yes, you can often add an icon or emoji to an account name in your email app's settings. Many email clients support this customization in account labels, helping you quickly identify inboxes.
